purpose: turn system behavior into numbers over time so trends, saturation and failure are visible before users complain
entry_criteria: Service level objectives are known or being defined
procedure: Instrument each service for the four golden signals: latency, traffic, errors and saturation.
Use consistent names and labels, and avoid labels with unbounded values such as user ids.
Collect infrastructure metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network) and dependency metrics (database, queues).
Build one overview dashboard per service answering 'is it healthy?' and drill-down dashboards for diagnosis.
Record business metrics for key flows so failures that technical metrics miss are visible.
Review dashboards after incidents and add the signals that would have helped.
acceptance_criteria: Each service exposes the four golden signals
An overview dashboard shows health at a glance
Business-flow metrics exist for critical journeys

validation.check: induce a small error rate in staging and watch the dashboard
validation.expect: the error panel shows it within the scrape interval

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The order service exposes request rate, error rate, latency histograms and queue depth. An induced error in staging appears on the overview dashboard within 30 seconds.
